controlled.saveEqualityPolicy: Normalize only IEEE-754 negative zero to positive zero before JSON serialization; every nonzero float bit and every canonical zero bit must survive exactly. Raw negative-zero sign bits are not preserved.

limitations: This is a new Unity6 controlled run. It does not establish real keyboard reception or revalidate the earlier physical Tuanjie run under Unity6.
The original Apartment geometry bridge and original key prefab fixture are bounded reconstruction inputs; complete gameplay and natural world-drop persistence remain absent.
Only original Locomotion and Action layers are enabled; original shader/material, missing-script and builtin-mesh limitations are re-observed rather than assumed fixed.
The saved inventory quantity is independently parsed from JSON. The cold trace proves reading the same bytes and exact pose, but emits no second in-memory inventory-count snapshot.
Raw editor, license and standard-stream logs remain private in .cache; only identities and safe process/build receipts are published.
Historical instanceId field names now carry complete unsigned 64-bit Unity6 EntityId values. They are runtime-local identities, not old 32-bit InstanceID values or cross-process object keys.
